detector: Closed 5m fast/slow SMA crossing. One-hour opportunity window ends at an opposite crossing of the same pair. No future-rally filter at detection or inference.
entry_target: Positive only if a candidate has >=10% observed best 24h gross gain and retains >=95% of the best eligible candidate gain in its setup window. All other fully observed candidates are negative, including losing and insufficient-gain setups. Unknown outcomes remain unlabeled.
exit_target: For entries sampled deterministically from all setups, successful or failed, close at or after that entry's observed best 5m..24h exit. Never restrict training to good entries. Uniform causal decision-step grid; no peak-based row sampling.
selection: Each of four networks independently chooses its checkpoint by earlier validation AP. Each side independently selects entry/exit thresholds by complete earlier continuous-replay gross PnL, or cash. Test outcomes never select parameters.
conflict_policy: If both sides qualify at the same symbol/time, wait. Within one side choose the highest scoring eligible pair; deterministic pair-index tie break. One position per symbol, and at most one entry per detector event.
comparison: Core and optional group retraining with paired initialization/minibatches and fixed full input layout. Same detectors, candidate data, labels, costs and chronological windows as no-news baseline.
test_status: Model-unseen chronological folds already examined in earlier research; not pristine research holdouts.
deployment: Offline only; news features excluded from every entry and exit model. Four final artifacts; no production activation.
